identified_issues: Authorization boundary collapse via quotient stage erasure across distinct operational contexts
Violation of Contract Boundary Invariance and the Principle of Least Privilege
Improper session caching aggregating disjoint permission sets into a permissive union
evidence: Workflow A defines explicit permitted actions limited to { READ, EXPORT_DRAFT, REQUEST_APPROVAL }
Compression middleware maps both workflows into a shared lightweight context 'AUTHORIZED_USER_SESSION' with combined_permissions containing the full union of rights
An interactive operator in Workflow A requested EXECUTE_MUTATION, an unpermitted action for that workflow, which was approved by the middleware
recommended_action: Decommission the coarse-grained session compression middleware. Preserve distinct session types and strongly typed permission models for Workflow A ('INTERACTIVE_OPERATOR_SESSION') and Workflow B ('APPROVED_BATCH_SESSION'). Implement regression tests to assert that callers in Workflow A are rejected with HTTP 403 Forbidden when attempting EXECUTE_MUTATION.
